title: Recently Stabilized
writeup: The table below provides an overview of concrete purpose-built rental developments that have stabilized in Vancouver West over the past five years; projects under 50 units were excluded from the comparable set. Larger-scale projects such as West 42 (West Building), Arbutus Residences (North and South Towers), and W2 required longer lease-up periods of approximately 11 to 18 months due to their size, though they maintained steady absorption throughout their leasing cycles. In contrast, Wilkinson stabilized over a much shorter timeframe, absorbing its 104 units in approximately three months. Excluding Wilkinson as an outlier at the high end of the set, leasing velocity ranged from approximately 6 to 16 units per month, averaging approximately 11 units per month. At this average pace, a 100-unit project would be expected to reach stabilization in approximately 9 months.
